name: What is the difference between a prefabricated shower unit and a custom-tiled shower?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a prefabricated shower unit and a custom-tiled shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main difference lies in construction and customization. A prefabricated shower unit is a factory-made, often one-piece or multi-panel enclosure made from acrylic or fiberglass. It's typically quicker and less expensive to install, offering a watertight solution with minimal seams. Custom-tiled showers are built on-site using a waterproof substrate, then finished with individual tiles. They offer unlimited design flexibility in terms of size, shape, tile patterns, and materials, allowing for a unique aesthetic, but they are generally more labor-intensive and costly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prefabricated units are factory-made, quicker to install, and more economical, while custom-tiled showers offer unlimited design flexibility but are more labor-intensive and costly.
